messages:
oliver: Heads-up 1 DeepWell (prospect) asked for a short perf validation before we hand final terms. Target: sustain 1k req/s steady, handle 2.5k bursts for ~5m, avg response ~210 tokens, p95 <= 450ms. They also want a Dedicated baseline and any security blockers up front. Meeting Thurs AM.
nina: Confirm prompt size + single-turn vs chat? hosted vs dedicated preference?
oliver: Single-turn, avg prompt ~160 tokens. They prefer Hosted for speed but asked for Dedicated pricing too.
carla: I'll run the bench tomorrow. Proposed plan: warm 6m -> 300rps; steps 300 -> 600 -> 1k -> 1.5k -> 2.5k (5m each); sustain 20m at 1k; spike 5m at 2.5k. Models: 13B-q4 and 34B-q4. Batch sizes [8,12], kv_cache on/off. Add X-Req-Id + token headers.
bench-bot: queued job perf-deepwell-6281 on cluster=perf-bench-eu, workers=56, eta=90s
ops: curl smoke for deck:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":210,"batch_size":8}'
```
carla: Quick smoke (13B-q4 batch=12 kv_cache off): p50=160ms p95=710ms p99=980ms errs=1.6% (timeouts at 1.5k-2.5k). Observed worker ingress queueing.
oliver: p95 too high. Try batch=8 and 34B-q4.
carla: Rerun 13B-q4 batch=8: p50=220ms p95=450ms p99=760ms errs=0.3%. Sustained 20m at 1k stable. Spike to 2.5k produced transient 503s but recovered.
carla: 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=200ms p95=410ms p99=690ms errs=0.4%. Higher mem per host so fewer GPUs fit per rack.
ops: KV cache hit rate for their prompt set ~9% (high variance) so don't rely on prefix caching for baseline.
sec: DeepWell security asks: CMEK (customer-managed keys), SOC2 PDF, network controls (VPC peering for Dedicated). We support AWS/GCP KMS, SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf. Dedicated supports VPC peering; hosted can use private endpoints & allowlist. Need a short key-rotation test window for CMEK.
oliver: Sales ask: concise cost + SLA recommendation to show on Thurs.
nina: Quick cost sketch (very preliminary):
- Hosted: steady 1k rps, avg 210 tokens -> est ~$30k/mo (infra + platform margin). Bursting raises usage but ballpark +10-20%.
- Dedicated: reserved fleet (~6-8 A100-eq) amortized infra ~$20k/mo + platform fee -> customer quote ~$26k-$29k/mo with SLA 99.9% and better tail.
carla: We'll include two configs in the deck: latency-optimized (34B-q4, batch8) and cost-optimized (13B-q4, batch12). Include p95/p99 charts and grafana snapshots.
bench-bot: run completed, artifacts uploaded to perf/6281234000/ (grafana + logs), end_ts=6281234321
ops: Note on failover: autoscaler routes traffic to spare hosts. If capacity exhausted, we throttle and surface 503s; we can configure automatic fallback to a smaller model variant if customer allows.
oliver: Action items: sec to send SOC2 + KMS checklist by EOD, carla final run summary + single-slide numbers by Wed noon, nina to draft Dedicated sizing & quote by Wed EOD, Ill book Thurs AM. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
